title: Executing SQL after a block comment whose closing line starts with dashes
summary: The merged SQL populator committed both original rows and ignored the sentinel in a line comment. The parent committed the first row and then failed. Its old three-argument direct client lost binary linkage on the merge.

change.description: The script reader retains a line containing the block-comment terminator, allowing the splitter to recognize the end of the block even when that line starts with the line-comment prefix.

notes: Each history reads the H2 table through a distinct JDBC connection. javap records the exact descriptor of the client compiled on the parent.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-jdbc 5.1.4.RELEASE. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
